name: Edward "Actuator" Warren
biography: Edward Warren is an Information Security Analyst and Independent Security Researcher specializing in IoT and mobile application security. Over the past few years he has discovered critical (CVSS) 0-day vulnerabilities. Edward also earned a Hall of Fame acknowledgement from the Google Play Security Reward Program (GPSRP) and attribution in numerous CVE publications. He has presented his work at conferences such as BSides and ShmooCon. When not tracking down digital bugs, Edward can be found hiking rugged trails or exploring the seas through his newfound fascination for scuba diving.
